text: Security is a crucial part of web development. One basic step is using HTTPS, which encrypts data between the user and the server. Authentication ensures that only authorized users can access certain parts of a website. Another important practice is input validation, which checks the data users enter to prevent harmful code from being processed. Developers must also be aware of common vulnerabilities, such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS). These attacks can steal data or damage a site. By following good security practices, developers can protect both their applications and their users from serious risks.
